body:
3 new stories in the Rochdale borough since yesterday morning.

The stories:

Is Rochdale Town Hall haunted? (Rochdale). Short answer: there is no verified evidence — the building’s ghost stories are local folklore and a programme of themed tours, not proven paranormal fact.

215th anniversary of Rochdale statesman John Bright's birth celebrated (Rochdale). Today marks 215 years since the birth of John Bright, a key figure in free trade and abolitionism, who was born in Rochdale.

Failsworth tram stop lifts out of service during replacement works (Rochdale). Passengers at Failsworth tram stop face disruptions as lifts are out of service, affecting access to services towards Rochdale and East Didsbury.

Weather: Partly cloudy 4°C in Rochdale today.

The Morning Briefing is published every day at 9am. Got a story? Tell the newsdesk.
